atAGlance: Tôm rang muối is salt-roasted shrimp, usually with garlic, chili, crisp shells, and rice.
whatItIs: Tôm rang muối is salt-roasted or salt-tossed shrimp, often shell-on, with a dry savory crust of salt, chili, garlic, or spices.
howToEnjoy: Peel if needed, then taste the salty crust before adding lime or chili. Shell-on shrimp can be messy, but the shell carries much of the flavor.
howLocalsOrder: Order tôm rang muối as a shared seafood plate. Ask whether shells remain, and say less chili before the shrimp is tossed with salt seasoning.
worthKnowing: Rang muối means roasted or tossed with salt seasoning, a common Vietnamese seafood style for slow sharing.
